Class IndexPriceRoundingService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.IndexPriceRoundingService
@Service public class IndexPriceRoundingService extends Object
Rounds the prices of index levels to the precision of their currency (gt.currency.precision) when they are delivered to the user interface. A connector often supplies an index with many more fraction digits than the index is published with, and showing them all suggests an accuracy that does not exist.

Only the response is rounded; the stored intraday and historical prices keep their full precision, so calculations, exports and GTNet are unaffected. Two kinds of instrument are left alone: everything that is not a SpecialInvestmentInstruments.NON_INVESTABLE_INDICES, and the securities that serve as the risk-free rate of a currency. The latter are indices too, but their quotes are interest rates rather than levels; with a currency precision of zero (JPY) the rate would otherwise collapse to zero.

      public Integer resolvePriceFractionDigits(Security security)
      Determines the number of fraction digits the prices of a single security are delivered with.
      Parameters:
      security - the security, may be null

      the precision of the security currency for a rounded index level, null when the prices keep their full precision

    • applyToSecurities

      public void applyToSecurities(Collection<Security> securities)
      Marks every index level of the collection so that its intraday prices are delivered rounded to its currency precision. Must be the last step before the response is returned, because the price getters return rounded values afterwards. The precision setting and the risk-free securities are read once for the whole collection.
      Parameters:
      securities - the securities of the response

    • roundHistoryquotes

      public void roundHistoryquotes(List<? extends BaseHistoryquote> historyquotes, int priceFractionDigits)
      Rounds open, high, low and close of history quotes. The quotes must be detached from the persistence context, otherwise the rounded values would be written back.
      Parameters:
      historyquotes - detached history quotes of one instrument
      priceFractionDigits - the number of fraction digits
